collateral_ratio_scale_basis: every collateral_ratio in this file is a PERCENT: 151.35 means 151.35%. Normalised on write from the snapshot's multiple so the shared backing_history.json column means one thing across assets; collateral_ratio_source_scale on each row names what it was converted from. Do not infer scale from the field name.
history_coverage: Collateral history starts 2026-09-22, the day the writer was added — NOT the day fxUSD started. No backfill was performed: the per-pool state this ratio is computed from is readable at historical blocks, but deriving it and presenting it beside live rows would mix two granularities in one series without saying so. The peg series (fxusd_peg_history.json) runs from 2025-08-01 and is unaffected.
collateral_ratio_basis: Sigma(raw collateral x the POOL'S OWN oracle anchor) / Sigma(pool debt). The wstETH pool's raw collateral is stETH-equivalent and its oracle prices stETH; multiplying that raw figure by a wstETH market price applies the wrap rate twice, which yields ~257% for a pool that reads ~208%. SETTLED 2026-09-22: riskAnalyst retracted 155.4% and published 150.6% (their ad163b9); the WBTC leg is the control — raw == held on a non-rebasing token beside raw/held == the wrap rate on a wrapped one establishes that getTotalRawCollaterals() returns the underlying. Residual against our reading is price timing, not basis. Recorded so a future correction reads as a basis change rather than the asset moving.
